name: Carnage

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Carnage için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Bloodlust
The sight and smell of blood triggers Carnage's bloodlust, granting a Power Gain Buff when activating a Bleed or Armor Break on the opponent that lasts as long as the Opponent is Bleeding or Armor Broken. The Power Gain grants up to [6.5 - 9.5]% of a Bar of Power per second based on how close Carnage is to the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: The Carnage Symbiote changes form creating weapons and armor which provide Passive bonuses based on Carnage's current needs.
Heavy Attack: Cruelty +[2,250] Critical Damage Rate

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Each time Carnage activates a Special Attack he begins to Mutate for 10 seconds.
Once his Mutation ends he copies his current Symbiotic Creation as a Permanent Buff.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: If the target is already Bleeding or Armor Broken, gain a 100% Chance to Bleed dealing [488.02] damage over 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [8,651.18] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Ravager - Passive
content: Carnage rips and tears at his opponents, each time he triggers a Bleed Debuff on his Opponent he has a 25% chance to Refresh the Duration of all the other Bleed Debuffs on his Opponent.
If a Bleed fails to apply due to an Immunity, Carnage has a 100% chance to Armor Break his Opponent, reducing their Armor by [1,833.33] lasting for 10 seconds. The Armor Break doesn't stack.
While his Opponent is Bleeding or Armor Broken, his Special Attacks become Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Carnage gains 50% additional Power from Striking his Opponent. This is reduced by 25% per Mutation Buff he has.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack receives [1,480.77] additional Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack receives [2,160.71] Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [50,576.1] Direct Damage over 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Bloodlust
content: The sight and smell of blood triggers Carnage's bloodlust, granting a Power Gain Buff when activating a Bleed or Armor Break on the opponent that lasts as long as the Opponent is Bleeding or Armor Broken. The Power Gain grants up to [6.5 - 9.5]% of a Bar of Power per second based on how close Carnage is to the opponent.
